target.title: fix(google): bound embedding batch file upload error body read
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

`response.text()` in the Gemini batch file upload error path read the
response body unbounded into memory. The error message also embedded the
full response body text.

## Why This Change Was Made

Replaced manual `response.ok` check + `response.text()` + `throw Error`
with the canonical `assertOkOrThrowProviderError`, which provides bounded
reads, redaction, and structured `ProviderHttpError` metadata — following
the pattern established in #102953 (steipete).

## User Impact

**Before:** unbounded `response.text()` + raw body in error message
**After:** bounded via `assertOkOrThrowProviderError`

## Evidence

Branch: `fix/google-embedding-error-body-file` | Base: `upstream/main` | Node: v22.19.0 Linux x64

### Tests

```
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/google/embedding-batch.test.ts
Test Files  1 passed (1)
```

### Diff

```
extensions/google/embedding-batch.ts | 6 ++-- (import swap + assertOkOrThrowProviderError)
```

- [x] I understand what the code does
- [x] Change is focused and does not mix unrelated concerns
